en.headline: Centre for Food Safety suspends poultry imports from North Lincolnshire in UK
en.dek: The move follows a World Organisation for Animal Health notification of highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza in the area, with the suspension taking immediate effect.
body: The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said on Tuesday that it had instructed the trade to suspend the import of poultry meat and products, including poultry eggs, from North Lincolnshire of Lincolnshire County in the United Kingdom with immediate effect.

The decision followed a notification from the World Organisation for Animal Health about an outbreak of highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza in the area. The centre said the measure was taken to protect public health in Hong Kong.

According to the Census and Statistics Department, Hong Kong imported about 680 tonnes of chilled and frozen poultry meat and about 220,000 poultry eggs from the United Kingdom in the first nine months of this year.

A spokesman said the centre had contacted the British authority over the issue and would closely monitor information issued by the World Organisation for Animal Health and the relevant authorities, taking appropriate action in response to developments.

zh.headline: 食安中心暫停英國林肯郡北林肯郡禽肉及禽類產品進口
zh.dek: 措施因應世界動物衞生組織通報當地爆發高致病性H5N1禽流感而即時生效，以保障本港公眾健康。
body: 食物環境衞生署食物安全中心周二表示，已指示業界即時暫停從英國林肯郡北林肯郡進口禽肉及禽類產品，包括禽蛋。
決定是因應世界動物衞生組織通報當地爆發高致病性H5N1禽流感。中心表示，措施旨在保障香港公眾健康。
根據政府統計處數字，今年首九個月本港從英國進口約680公噸冰鮮及冷藏禽肉，以及約22萬隻禽蛋。
發言人表示，中心已就事件聯絡英國當局，並會密切監察世界動物衞生組織及相關機構發出的資訊，因應情況採取適當行動。
